paths.description: Popular/recent listing: entry page and primary discovery template.
Representative video detail and age-verification-to-play journey.
Trust and privacy policy content template.
Invalid route used to inspect HTTP and recovery state.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not follow the user’s light/dark preference.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule; the page stays dark under emulation rather than adapting to the requested scheme.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens so browser UI and surfaces follow the user.

findings.summary: Motion is not reduced when the user requests it.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-reduced-motion rule while lazy thumbnails use a 0.2s opacity transition and the loading bar defines an infinite animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a reduced-motion media query that removes non-essential transitions and stops infinite loading motion.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not supported.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling; Lighthouse also measured tag text at 4.37:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors/prefers-contrast styles and strengthen muted text/control contrast.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps pages abruptly.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition usage on this multi-page site despite frequent listing-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin listing/detail navigation, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: The fixed header does not communicate scroll state.
findings.evidence: The rendered CSS fixes .header at the top but contains no scroll-state query or progress/shrink state across a 6,312px listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header treatment or progress affordance.

findings.summary: Menus are manually positioned rather than resiliently anchored.
findings.evidence: The language, settings, geo and filter panels use absolute top/right/left offsets; the CSS probe found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Anchor menus to their triggers with CSS Anchor Positioning and fallback positions.

findings.summary: Route and filter changes provide little attention guidance.
findings.evidence: The long listing has no transition/highlight/scroll-marker mechanism; the CSS probe found no View Transition, scroll marker, or scroll timeline support.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve context and highlight the destination/current state when navigating or filtering.

findings.summary: Custom overlays reimplement platform semantics.
findings.evidence: Across listing, watch, and policy probes there are zero dialog, popover, and details elements; language/filter/age-gate UI is built from custom positioned elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover for transient menus and dialog for modal verification, preserving light-dismiss and focus semantics.

findings.summary: The primary watch page is wider than the mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport the watch layout reported scrollWidth 734px and 374px horizontal overflow, while the listing reported zero overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the desktop-width constraint from the player/watch template and size media and surrounding content to min(100%, container).

findings.summary: Core controls have small targets and invisible focus.
findings.evidence: The search input/button are 30px high, the language control is 26px high, and focused search controls compute outline:none with no box-shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44px touch targets and explicit :focus-visible styles with adequate contrast.

findings.summary: The initial listing load includes avoidable network overhead.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 42 requests and 1.32MB transferred; the 112KB HTML document was reported uncompressed and 30 third-party requests transferred 1.10MB. DOM confirmation shows candidate scripts are async/defer, so the issue is weight rather than falsely claimed render blocking.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress HTML, delay non-essential third parties, and load preview media only after intent/visibility.

findings.summary: Large portions of third-party JavaScript are unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 203KiB of unused JavaScript, led by Google Analytics, Yandex Metrica, and the ad provider.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics/ad vendors and conditionally load the remaining scripts after consent or interaction.

findings.summary: Several controls and embedded assets lack robust accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an untitled iframe and a language button whose aria-label “Language” omits visible text “English”; the image audit found one missing alt, and the search input has no label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a programmatic search label, title ad/media frames, align visible and accessible names, and provide appropriate alt text.

findings.summary: Muted navigation text misses WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured #888 text on #242424 at 4.37:1 for Popular, Watching now, and tags, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise the muted foreground contrast and verify all states at WCAG AA.

findings.summary: The page lacks a main landmark and suppresses visible focus on search controls.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found no main landmark. The focus probe shows outline:none and no focus shadow for the search input and button.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main> and add consistent :focus-visible indicators without removing native focus unless replaced.

findings.summary: The watch experience does not reflow and its video exposes no caption track.
findings.evidence: The 360px watch capture overflows by 374px; the media probe found a video with no <track> captions, and several targets are under 44px.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix watch-page reflow, enlarge targets, and provide captions/transcripts for meaningful video.

findings.summary: Image assets omit intrinsic sizing and responsive candidates.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 24 of 27 images without width/height and all 27 without srcset; Lighthouse also flagged low-resolution previews.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and provide responsive srcset/sizes with suitable source resolution.

findings.summary: Policy pages omit meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: The privacy and removal probes found descriptive titles and H1s but no meta description on either public policy page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add unique summaries for policy pages so search/share results explain their purpose.

findings.summary: Listing and policy templates lack share/entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The listing, search, privacy, and removal probes found zero Open Graph and JSON-LD blocks; only the watch detail provides rich metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph metadata and appropriate CollectionPage/ItemList or organization/policy structured data.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookie defaults are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present, but CSP is missing. Eight first-party cookies were observed without a usable SameSite value and three (_ga, _ga_W5TSJNM83B, __suvt) lacked Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and set Secure plus Lax/Strict SameSite wherever cross-site use is not essential.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising dominate the request surface.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 30/42 third-party requests and 1.10MB/1.32MB third-party bytes. Tracker evidence found Google Analytics and 12 third-party origins including Yandex/Webvisor and ad networks.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential tracking behind informed consent, and avoid full-session analytics by default.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive headers are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP, clickjacking protection, or Permissions-Policy; Referrer-Policy is the weak no-referrer-when-downgrade value.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options), a restrictive Permissions-Policy, and strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy.

findings.summary: The advertised standalone app has no offline runtime.
findings.evidence: A standalone web app manifest is present, but navigator.serviceWorker.controller is false and no service-worker runtime was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: If retaining standalone app positioning, register a service worker and provide an offline fallback; otherwise avoid implying installable app resilience.

findings.summary: The multilingual UI relies heavily on physical positioning.
findings.evidence: html lang=en and a five-language switcher are present, but rendered CSS repeatedly uses left/right/top offsets and the html dir attribute is empty, making RTL adaptation fragile.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction for translated locales and replace physical layout properties with logical inline/block properties.

findings.summary: Pop-under advertising undermines predictable, user-controlled navigation.
findings.evidence: The page loads a script named popunder1000.js from a third-party ad network before user interaction; HAR and Lighthouse also show extensive ad/tracking cookie activity.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove pop-under behavior and use clearly labelled, non-disguised advertising that never opens unexpected contexts.

findings.summary: The image pipeline is not responsive or format-consistent.
findings.evidence: All 27 images lack srcset, seven are legacy format, and Lighthouse reports preview images below the required rendered resolution.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP responsive sources and retain intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Substantial media and analytics work begins before user intent.
findings.evidence: The initial age-gated listing transferred a 627KB MP4 preview plus analytics/ad scripts; third-party work accounts for 1.10MB while content remains blurred until verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch preview media or non-essential analytics until consent, visibility, and user intent; deprioritise background work.

findings.summary: Third-party and media cost is disproportionate to the initial task.
findings.evidence: Thirty third-party requests transfer 1.10MB of a 1.32MB load, including tracking, ads, and preview media before age verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove redundant vendors, and lazy-load media/ads after the core listing is usable.

taskList.title: Fix watch-page mobile reflow, focus visibility, targets, and captions
Remove pop-under behavior and minimise/gate tracking and advertising vendors
Deploy CSP, clickjacking/permissions policies, and secure SameSite cookie defaults
Restore accessible semantics, names, landmarks, focus, and contrast
Make image delivery responsive and defer preview media until intent
Respect theme, reduced-motion, and contrast preferences
Add robust navigation/menu positioning and attention cues
Complete metadata, multilingual layout, and offline positioning
